package consumer

import (
	"errors"
	di "github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection"
	"github.com/cratis/fundamentals.go/dependencyinjection/container"
	"testing"
)

func TestForeignOwnerRetainedWithAttestedLifetime(t *testing.T) {
	Calls = 0
	var r container.Registry
	if err := di.BindValue(&r, &Dependency{}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	external := &External{}
	if err := di.BindValue(&r, external); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := RegisterForeign(&r); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := RegisterServices(&r); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if Calls != 0 {
		t.Fatal("dual-generator registration activated constructor")
	}
	if err := RegisterServices(&r); !errors.Is(err, di.ErrDuplicate) {
		t.Fatal("unlisted duplicate skipped", err)
	}
	p, err := r.Build()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	a, err := p.NewScope(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b, err := p.NewScope(t.Context())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	first, err := di.Resolve[IFoo](t.Context(), a)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	second, err := di.Resolve[*Foo](t.Context(), b)
	if err != nil || first != second {
		t.Fatal("forwarder ignored attested existing lifetime", err)
	}
	if err := a.Close(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := b.Close(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if second.Closes != 0 {
		t.Fatal("existing singleton disposed with scope")
	}
	if err := p.Close(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if second.Closes != 1 || external.Closes != 0 {
		t.Fatal("borrowed forwarding or external ownership differs")
	}
}
